description:
## Goal

Add full initiative management UX to the dashboard. Users should be able to create, edit, reorder, and manage initiatives and their member items directly from the dashboard.

## Implementation

### Initiative Detail View
Clicking an initiative card on the dashboard opens an initiative detail view (either a new route `/dashboard/:initiative` or an inline expandable panel). Contains:
- **Header:** Title, description, priority, status, target date (all editable inline)
- **Item list:** All backlog items in this initiative, sorted by dependency order
  - Each item shows: kind icon, name, status badge, priority, effort, blocked-by indicator
  - Quick actions per item: view details, queue, archive
- **Dependency graph:** Visual or textual representation of the initiative's internal dependency chain
- **Progress timeline:** If target_date is set, show progress against deadline

### Create Initiative Flow
- "New Initiative" button on the dashboard page
- Opens a creation dialog with: name, title, description, priority, status, target_date
- After creation, prompts to add existing backlog items or create new ones

### Edit Initiative
- Inline editing on the detail view (click to edit title, description, etc.)
- Priority adjustment (number input or up/down buttons)
- Status transitions (active → paused → completed → archived)

### Item Management
- Add existing backlog items to an initiative (search + select)
- Remove items from an initiative
- Reorder items within an initiative (drag or priority adjustment)
- Create new backlog items directly within the initiative context (pre-fills the initiative field)

### Delete/Archive Initiative
- Archive initiative (items remain but initiative is hidden from dashboard)
- Delete initiative (items are disassociated, not deleted)
- Confirmation dialog for both actions

## Key Files

- Initiative API: `scenarios/swarm-manager/api/internal/backlog/handler.go`
- Initiative CLI: `scenarios/swarm-manager/cli/cmd_backlog.go` (initiatives commands)
- Domain types: `scenarios/swarm-manager/ui/src/types/domain.ts`
- Backlog service: `scenarios/swarm-manager/ui/src/services/backlog-service.ts`
- Dashboard page (new): wherever the dashboard page was created in execute/swarm-manager-dashboard-page
